statements.statement: The procedure code billed was CPT 93247
The denial reason code was CO-197
The diagnosis codes were I49.9 and I25.10
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and exertional chest tightness
There is concern for an underlying arrhythmia in the context of established atherosclerotic heart disease
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring was ordered to characterize the frequency and morphology of these events and correlate symptoms with cardiac rhythm disturbances
The service was denied because required prior authorization was not obtained
